doc.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Why his siblings would not stay in New York
summary: His brothers and sisters found New York too fast and returned to Indianapolis; Brower muses the family band was ahead of its time.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Why? Different reasons, I’m sure, but if you could sum it up, why?
They felt more comfortable in Indianapolis, because they knew people there. They knew the city.
They felt that New York was fast. It was fast. They just didn’t have the desire to stay there. There were a lot of opportunities there. They wouldn’t stay.
We think about the Marsalis family, but they only have a sextet.
Didn’t want to work Mom too hard.
It seems as if your band was ahead of its time. If you had been – if your dad had come along about 30-some years later, I don’t know – maybe you might be running Lincoln Center.
